source: Michigan Lottery listed retail instant inventory

catalogs.coverage: Retail instant games listed in the official web lobby and available in stores, matched by official IGT ID. Prize inventory is not dated claims or retailer-linked winning activity. Pull Tabs and unlisted inventory rows are excluded.
catalogs.updateCadence: Checked every six hours; source cadence unconfirmed.
